body:
## Summary

- keep the recovered WAL attached to the segment after replay
- ensure `Optimize()` flushes data restored from the WAL before sealing the segment
- add a crash-recovery regression test covering optimize, close, and reopen

## Root cause

Segment recovery replayed WAL records into memory using a local WAL handle, then closed it without restoring the member WAL handle. `Optimize()` subsequently treated the writing segment as having no WAL records and skipped persistence, so recovered documents disappeared after reopening.

## Impact

Recovered documents are now persisted when a collection is optimized immediately after crash recovery.

Fixes #594.

## Validation

- all 6 `CrashRecoveryTest` cases pass locally
- full CI matrix passed on the same commit: Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, iOS, lint, and clang-tidy
- `git diff --check` passes
title: fix: optimize after crash recovery without opening wal
